PATCH

Patches the remaining untranslated UI gaps across all locales — the leaves that were still holding English values (legal-footer links, featured label, docs-portal strings, pref labels, OFF toggle, star-field vocabulary for tln) — and transliterates every name/label to Cyrillic for ru per the "all names in Cyrillic" directive.

Keys are dot-paths into db.translations[locale]; array indexes are numeric segments. Only listed paths are written — everything else is left untouched. Cognates that are already correct in the target language (e.g. "Normal" in pt/es/de, "Contact" in fr/nl) are intentionally absent.

setPath

Sets obj's leaf at a dot-path, creating intermediate containers.
